query: Điều trị ALL theo phác đồ FRALLE 2000 bao gồm các giai đoạn nào?

history.llm_response: The ALL-REZ-BFM 85 protocol, which is an amended version of the FRALLE 2000 protocol, consists of nine phases (sensitization and induction R1, R2, each phase consisting of four cycles). Each cycle is spaced 21 days or one week after the bone marrow recovery following the previous treatment (white blood cell count > 1.5G/L; platelet count > 100G/L). These phases include methylprednisone, vincristine, methotrexate, leucovorin, and cytarabine. The specific phases of the ALL-REZ-BFM 85 protocol within the FRALLE 2000 are not explicitly stated in the provided context, but it can be inferred that they are part of the treatment regimen mentioned in Context 2 and Context 3.
